  1. The supply and demand of child pornography are both exploding. -- online traffic in CP is growing exponentially, and about half of all CP servers are located in the U.S. Producing ever-growing quantities of CP requires ever-growing numbers of victims.

  4. In recent years there have been repeated, documented cover-ups of child sex abuse.
